passageOverrides.after: M3-B r7 item 14 (unit B2-c1): the narrow security surface the host native unit instrument consumes: public mirror types of the shared discovery rule, thin functions calling the rule (one rule, called, never copied), and AdmittedBoundaries, the admitted V3 boundary inventory, constructible in production only by security, with its boundary predicates. passageOverrides.before: M3-C r8 items 1 and 3 (unit C1c-0; C1c plan r4): the read set's security primitives, ahead of the read set itself (C1c-1). open_pruned is the pruned-tree capture opener for C2's layout reads: from the retained root by no-follow opens, each directory observed through its parent, opened and compared, judged under S3 directory custody above the dependency anchor only and under descriptor discipline at and below it, an installed manifest never judged under config-file custody, and a path with no dependency segment, a VCS segment or a custody anchor refused before any open. authorize_read is the shared rule's read_set_path over the full path with the same session's walk evidence (WalkEvidence), charged its counted cost; observes_dependency_cargo_root is the charged no-follow Cargo.toml observation. Opens descriptors and reads no content; every step charged to the caller's ledger first; library only, with no production caller.
passageOverrides.after: M3-C r8 items 1 and 3 (unit C1c-0; C1c plan r4): the read set's security primitives, ahead of the read set itself (C1c-1). open_pruned is the pruned-tree capture opener for C2's layout reads: from the retained root by no-follow opens, each directory observed through its parent, opened and compared, judged under S3 directory custody above the dependency anchor only and under descriptor discipline at and below it, an installed manifest never judged under config-file custody, and a path with no dependency segment, a VCS segment or a custody anchor refused before any open. authorize_read is the shared rule's read_set_path over the full path with the same session's walk evidence (WalkEvidence), charged its counted cost; observes_dependency_cargo_root is the charged no-follow Cargo.toml observation. Unit C2b-0 (C2b plan r3) adds the node_modules layout's primitives beside the opener: reach_directory, the no-follow directory reach from the retained root, judged under S3 directory custody above the first node_modules segment or throughout a first-party path and under the descriptor discipline at and below it; list_directory, a reached directory's listing at the walk's price, dot names dropped and every other name observed no-follow; read_link, one charged readlinkat of a symlink's stored text through the held descriptor, never followed (None for a text that is not UTF-8); observe_entry and reached_dependency_cargo_root, no-follow observations; layout_exclusion, the extent's and the shared rule's excluded_path judgment of one path, charged before either runs; and resolve_link with resolve_link_cost, the lexical resolution of a link's text, which opens and follows nothing. Opens descriptors and reads no regular-file content: the only bytes it reads are a symlink's stored text, by read_link, and source contents are read only by crates/host/src/snapshot.rs; every step charged to the caller's ledger first; library only, with no production caller.
